question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Peruse
solution:
The correct answer is "**Check.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• **Peruse means to read or examine carefully.**

 
 
• Example: He perused the contract before signing it.
 
 
 
• **Check also means to examine or inspect carefully, which is a synonym of peruse.**
 
 
• ​Example: You need to check the documents correctly.
 
 
 
 
 
• ​​Thus, it can be concluded that the word "check" is the correct synonym of the word "peruse."

​​Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2,** Draw, **means to make a picture or diagram.
 
• Option 3, **Pursue**, means to follow or chase after something.
 
• Option 4, **Narrate**, means to tell a story or give an account of something.
